osorio_p1.name: EE-T1 Osório (105)
osorio_p1.authority: Main ruled the Brazil line on 2026-10-29 (DECISIONS) on the owner's request the same day ("lets build brazil, not taiwan, and flesh it out with all its own tanks"): the 105 mm P.1 at tier III, the same Engesa hull and Vickers turret as the P.2 (Bastos 2003), a photo-class first-party build; no registered 3D comparison exists. Numerical 3D comparison remains unverified.
osorio_p1.envelopeBasis: Width, length and tallest are the as-built envelope of the shared Osório build: published 7.13 m hull, 9.36 m over the 105 mm L7A3, 3.26 m over the skirts, 2.37 m to the turret roof and 2.68 m to the sight (Engesa's sheet; Jane's via Nita). The P.1's kit (the two OIP LRS-5 heads, 2x2 dischargers, the fender mirrors, the glacis travel lock, the L7's fume extractor) as the 2015 museum and 2024 Curitiba photographs show it; the envelope holds the mirrors, the M2HB and the whips.
